cs.t: My Bose headphones are wired and much bulkier and heavy. They are good if you do not move around. The Adidas are much lighter. They are designed to be worn while you are active. You can even disassemble and wash them. I know Bose has a wireless version but I don't own it.
cs.th: Ask HN: What did you purchase that measurably improved your quality of life?
